evidence_items.locator: Section 2, Accumulating Data Avoids Model Collapse in Deep Generative Models
evidence_items.explanation: The experiments support collapse under one training arrangement and its avoidance under another. They challenge an automatic ingestion-to-collapse inference but do not establish the forecast's antecedent or an actual company-model collapse.
This documents intentional use of generated training material. It does not establish that a shortage forced that choice or that the resulting model lost its usefulness.

unresolved_gaps: No cited record establishes that the specified scarcity-driven desperation occurred.
No located evidence traces that condition through ingestion to destruction of a company model's usefulness.
There is no deadline at which absence of collapse would count as failure.
